newsitem.title: USA: LCI International wins Bluewater contract.
newsitem.headline: LCI International wins Bluewater contract.

text.p: LCI International Inc said it signed a multi-year contract worth about $32 million to provide its long-distance network to support Bluewater Communications's prepaid calling cards.
LCI said it will handle all customer support for the calling cards through its prepaid calling card customer service center.
Bluewater provides prepaid calling cards to independent and chain retail operations throughout the U.S., Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
